settings.eyebrow: Your escape on the Azure Coast
settings.headline:
Wake up to
waves, not alarms.
settings.copy: Azure Bay is an all-inclusive beachfront resort where the sand is steps from your door and every sunset ends in a toast. Relax, reconnect, and let the ocean set the pace.

settings.title: A place to stay
settings.intro: Every room faces the water. Wake to the sun rising over the bay and fall asleep to the tide.

features.title: Ocean-view suites
features.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows, a private balcony, and a king bed that makes leaving hard.

features.title: Beachfront villas
features.text: Your own pool, direct beach access, and a dedicated concierge for the ultimate escape.

features.title: Family bungalows
features.text: Two bedrooms, a kitchenette, and plenty of room for the kids to run around.

features.title: All-inclusive dining
features.text: Four restaurants and two bars — from fresh seafood to wood-fired pizza — all included.

features.title: Pools & spa
features.text: Infinity pools, a kids' splash zone, and a full-service spa for some serious R&R.

features.title: Water sports
features.text: Paddleboarding, snorkeling, sailing, and jet-ski rentals right on our beach.

settings.title: Days you'll talk about
settings.image_caption: Sunset catamaran cruise — our most-booked excursion

paragraphs.text: Beyond the beach, Azure Bay curates a calendar of experiences: sunset catamaran cruises, guided reef snorkeling, cooking classes with our chefs, and kids' adventure camps.
Prefer to do nothing at all? We've perfected that too. Lounge under a palm, order from the swim-up bar, and let the day dissolve into evening.

settings.quote: The best days here are the ones you plan the least.

settings.title: Questions, answered
settings.intro: The details guests ask about most before booking.

items.question: What's included in an all-inclusive stay?
items.answer: All meals at our four restaurants, drinks at the bars, daily activities, and use of the pools and beach equipment. Spa treatments and premium excursions are extra.

items.question: Is Azure Bay family-friendly?
items.answer: Absolutely. We have family bungalows, a kids' splash zone, supervised adventure camps, and high chairs and cribs available in every family room.

items.question: What's the cancellation policy?
items.answer: Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival. Within 7 days, a one-night charge applies. Peak-season bookings have slightly different terms.

items.question: How do I get to the resort?
items.answer: We're a 40-minute drive from the airport. Airport transfers can be arranged through our concierge for a small fee.

settings.title: Let's plan your escape
settings.intro: Tell us your dates and how many are coming — our team will send you a tailored quote within a day.
